body: We should probably add some explanatory text about what exactly this accomplishes. It puts it in the normal HTTP cache, respecting normal HTTP headers (so, e.g., if you use `Cache-Control: no-store`, the prefetch is pointless). It also respects storage partitioning, so using it on cross-site resources will generally only be useful if you're, e.g., prefetching an iframe document.
